rationale: Static inspection supports the test design: the frozen hyperbolic operators implement the stated radial exp/log maps, Mobius addition, distance and boundary clamp; the math oracle includes independent closed forms (including a correct multidimensional radial exp case); the gradient suite includes a separately written Mobius-offset central-difference oracle and invokes the model and trainer imports; the DDP suite spawns two ranks with rank-distinct data, gathers each rank's gradients and post-step parameters with all_gather, and checks the persisted per-rank observations; and the entrypoint suite calls trainer.main(), witnesses its compute_loss path, and checks checkpoint/SID/JSON artifacts. The trainer source itself contains the claimed DDP launcher and train/optimizer/export flow. However, this sandbox has no shell or torch and offers no file-byte/hash computation facility. I therefore could not recompute the source digest using the manifest's sorted-path/NUL/per-file-hash recipe, nor independently verify the reviewed test files' SHA-256 values against their bytes. This leaves required hash/test drift evidence unresolved, so I cannot approve. No suites were executed: Stage2 verification_check must run all four against the project interpreter and establish nonzero tests, no skips, and no failures. Static review does not substitute for that execution proof.
